profile.headline: Software Engineer III @ Global Payments Inc. | ITIL Certified
profile.summary:
Global Payments Inc. benefits from contributions to IT service management and data integration. Recent efforts focus on designing and implementing custom asset discovery jobs for UCMDB and ServiceNow, streamlining workflows and enhancing data integrity.

Prior work at KellyMitchell Group, Inc. and Intact Technology strengthened competencies in UCMDB administration, system integration, and discovery optimization. Projects included integrating Infoblox with Micro Focus' UCMDB/UD and enabling robust asset reporting environments through UCMDB and Flexera’s Technopedia. Dedicated to delivering innovative solutions and ensuring seamless data management.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented custom discovery jobs and integrations in ServiceNow and UCMDB, enhancing data accuracy.  
• Assisted in optimizing workflow efficiency through the design and implementation of ServiceNow.  
• Managed discovery processes in ServiceNow and UCMDB, ensuring seamless operation and data integrity.  
• Developed and maintained service maps in ServiceNow to improve service visibility.

positions.title: Senior Technical Consultant
positions.description:
Key member of the Configuration/Asset Management implementation project team and was responsible for the overall design of the platform and mapping client business requirements to systems/technical requirements. Worked as a team member along with the Project Manager and supporting team members to deliver the complete CMDB/Asset Management solution for the customer. 

	Designed and implemented an integration between Infoblox and Micro Focus’ UCMDB/UD to automatically add subnets into the discovery range of UD.

	Designed and implemented an integration between UCMDB and Flexera’s Technopedia to enable a robust reporting environment for assets.

	Analyzed and optimized UCMDB/UD discovery and CI archiving speeding up nightly discovery by 25%.

	Devised and implemented strategy to model all critical business applications within a two-month timeframe in UCMDB.

positions.title: Principal Infra Developer
positions.description: Drive solution building in emerging/complex technology areas; provide advisory support to clients in areas of specialization; Guide and support infra development across multiple engagements within technology/domain area under purview based on expertise with the objective of building and nurturing capabilities and ensuring robust infra development, in complex technology-domain areas.

positions.title: Senior Technical Consultant
positions.description:
Post sales architecture, implementation and configuration of HPE UCMDB, Configuration Management tools as well as Release Management tools. Created custom discovery and integrations solutions written in both Jython, Java and Javascript. Worked both onsite and remotely with customers from the US, Canada, Mexico, Brazil and Australia.

•	Designed Configuration Management processes for four customers.
•	Contributed four integration modules that became out of the box modules.
•	Drove two Enhancement Requests to new releases.

positions.title: Senior Systems Consultant
positions.description:
Technical member of a sales team for all Oracle, SQL Server, Sybase, DB2 database management and monitoring products. Helped with technical qualifications of potential customers, technical q&a from potential customers, demos, trade show booth duty, and RFIs.

• Achieved more than 200% of quota twice and was selected to attend President's Club.

positions.title: Technical Account Manager
positions.description:
Responsible for ensuring current customers in territory were compliant with licenses, getting necessary support. Presented new releases and new offerings to existing customers.

• Achieved 200% of quota for the quarter.

positions.title: Product Specialist
positions.description:
Technical member of a sales team for all UNIX/Windows Oracle and Informix database products. Helped with technical qualifications of potential customers, technical q&a from potential customers, demos, trade show booth duty, rfis, etc.

• Achieved 150% of quota and selected for President's Club.
